dra-certs.g: Who holds a valid Debt Recovery Agent certificate
dra-certs.w: Every employee's IIBF DRA certificate status and expiry, read from the employee record and ordered so the ones expiring within the configured window come first, then the expired, then the valid. Banks authorise only certified agents; an expired certificate is a visit the bank can refuse to recognise.
f: Expiring within the window listed first
One click to the employee to record a renewal
CSV of exactly the rows shown
s: Send the due-within-window agents for revalidation.
Record the new expiry on the employee's form.
dra-certs.tip: The window is expiry_window_days in config/field-reports.json — change the number, not the code.

complaints.g: Borrower complaints against agents, to closure
complaints.w: A register of complaints received against field agents — source, channel, severity, date and status — so a pattern against one agent is visible before a bank sees it, and every complaint has a recorded outcome.
f: Source, channel and severity per complaint
Linked to the employee complained about
s: Log the complaint the day it arrives.
Record the outcome when the review ends.
Reports → Complaints by status shows what is still open.
complaints.tip: Substantiated complaints belong on the agent's record before the next bank authorisation is issued.
